source: Three conditions matched by task and replicate number: historical no-skill and previous-skill on 2026-11-25 and current-skill on 2026-11-27. Independent model samples on different dates; control did not run again. The two skill versions were jointly re-reviewed under anonymous IDs; the historical no-skill review is frozen.

definitions.elapsed_s: Wall time of the Codex CLI trial, including tool calls and recovery; excludes reference and grading.
definitions.time_to_first_orca_s: Kernel-confirmed ORCA main process creation time minus recorded CLI launch time. The historical start timestamp was written just before tempdir/CLI setup, so it is a close upper bound. A separate common metadata-origin column is provided.
definitions.lookups: Source inspections or CLI --help calls for installed scripts' input or argument contract before the first actual ORCA launch. Include a source read made earlier in the same tool call as the launch, distinguish it from a standalone prelaunch call. Multiple lookups in a single call count once. Reading SKILL.md/chemistry.md alone is excluded.
definitions.repeated_parameter_lookup: At least two separate prelaunch calls revisited the same runner interface/parameter concern. Manually checked against call source and returned output.
definitions.recorded_tool_wall_s: Sum of OS receipt resource_usage.wall_seconds across observed calls; the session remaining time includes model, harness and other overhead and is not a pure model-latency measurement.
definitions.driver_count: Distinct Windows JobObject members with staged ORCA executable identity, OS PID and birth time; helper mentions or completed parse do not count.
definitions.diagnostics: Explicit retained model/tool/native failures and redundant launches are described separately; absence of traces cannot rule out unobserved activity.
